create_async_task_with_fork: create an asynchronous TorchScript task using torch.jit.fork with a callable and arguments
wait_for_future_result: wait for a torch.jit.Future to complete and retrieve its computed result

trace_fork_calls_in_ir_graph: trace fork and wait calls so they are captured in the exported TorchScript IR graph
